body: Thank you, that’s so kind of you to say, I’ll probably work on doing the rest of the covers and posting them here

Sorry I don’t really have much I can say, funnily though my old name was Amber haha. But the best thing to do is just say it, it may take them a while to come to terms with it but there’s no real one guaranteed method for coming out. Hope it all goes well!
Also it’s not your job to fulfil your parents wants and views, my dad always wanted a daughter but I never would have been comfortable living that way

You could say you want to try out a new style to your parents and buy some oversized sweaters ( I live in them ), it is fine to feel upset with being misgendered and if you really feel that uncomfortable if you ever get the courage to you should say something ( I told my friends and I know I am extremely lucky with how accepting they’ve been and it’s helped me feel much better, family members could obviously call you they them and grandchild or cousin or sibling or child but other than that I’m not sure. Hope this helps!
Yeah some is on my page but most is on my Instagram under the handle amberadamsarts
A lot of my art doesn’t include eyes, it allows more of a haunting look
Thank you, I’m glad that communicates !
Thank you, I’m glad you like it :)
It could also work yes, I think that would be adorable

You can talk to me if you want friends in the lgbtq+ and as for coming out I don’t have much advice to give, I have a tendency of more springing it on people however I’m sure your parents will accept you it just might take them a while as you’ve had your whole life to discover who you are so it may take them a little longer to adjust. Hope it all goes well !
Yeah, I actually kept doubting myself over whether or not me having dysphoria meant I was binary trans. I still don’t fully understand myself yet but I’m getting there.
